name: MonkeyWorkout
subtitle: Gym plans, Coach and Watch
promotionalText: Your week of gym sessions, built around your gym's machines, your sports and how you feel today. Log every set in one tap, on iPhone or Apple Watch.
description: MonkeyWorkout plans your gym week, runs every session set by set and shows what it does for you. Built for real gyms, real machines and real weeks.
YOUR WEEK, PLANNED
• A plan built from your goal, your days and the machines your gym actually has
• Your sports stay in the week: climbing, running, padel, swimming and more
• Away, sick or short on time? Move, skip or shorten a day and the week adapts
• Auto-tune reads your sleep, heart-rate variability and recent load to pick today's weights
A PLAYER THAT NEVER GETS IN THE WAY
• One screen per exercise: weight, reps, rest and what's next, no scrolling
• Log a set in one tap; the next weight is suggested from your history
• 3D position guide for every exercise, machine setup saved per machine
• Supersets, HIIT, EMOM, AMRAP, Tabata and boxing rounds
• Form check with the camera: on-device body pose, rep by rep feedback, nothing recorded
APPLE WATCH
• Start, log and finish on the wrist, mirrored live with your iPhone
• Heart rate, rep counting, swims, climbs and sports tracked into Apple Health
• Smart Stack, complications, double tap and the Action button
COACH
• Coach Monkey explains today's plan and answers questions about your training
• Spoken cues during sets and rest
PROGRESS, MIND AND FUEL
• Strength, volume and estimated 1-rep max for every lift, muscle map of your week
• Mind: daily mood check-in, guided breathing and a Mind score next to your Body score
• Fuel: water, meals, protein and supplements
SOCIAL
• Share workouts, records and levels as stories; copy a friend's workout in one tap
• Weekly challenges, levels and badges
PRIVACY

No ads, no tracking. Your data is never sold. Coach's AI features (Anthropic) get only what each one needs, never your name or email, and are not used to train models. Delete your account and all its data from the app at any time.

MonkeyWorkout Pro unlocks Ask Coach, Generate-and-do-today, gym scan, fridge scan and saving workouts from videos. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage them in your Apple Account settings.
Terms of Use: https://workout.monkeygrade.cloud/terms
Privacy Policy: https://workout.monkeygrade.cloud/privacy

notes: Sign in with the demo account below (email + password) or with Sign in with Apple.
The demo account has a gym, a weekly plan and past workouts. To try a workout: Train tab > Start workout > tap SET 1 DONE > Workout menu > Finish.
Apple Watch: install the Watch app, then start from the Watch's Home or from iPhone (Start on Watch).
Form check: exercise page (Explore) > Check my form. The camera image is processed on device only; nothing is recorded or uploaded.
Account deletion: Me > Settings > Delete account.

AI: Ask Coach, the weekly Coach review, Talk to Coach mid-set, plan setup, meal ideas, gym / fridge scans and Save from a video send only the data each needs to Anthropic (Claude), without name, email or account id; listed in the privacy policy section AI features.
Community content: report and block on every post and profile; posts are filtered and hidden after 3 reports.
